name: compact-nudge
description: Nudge the user to run /compact once the session context passes a token threshold, with a ready-to-edit /compact command drafted from the conversation. Claude Code only: a function-hook pane on the terminal and desktop app, a command-hook fallback everywhere else; never compacts on its own.

threshold.title: Nudge threshold (tokens)
threshold.description: First nudge milestone, in context tokens; lowered to 80% of the context window when the window is smaller.

step.title: Re-nudge step (tokens)
step.description: Distance between nudge milestones after the threshold: threshold, threshold + step, threshold + 2 * step, and so on.
